queries_run: Mastercard largest customer in-house network OR second source OR insourcing 2026
Mastercard issuer concentration customer moves volume to Visa OR competitor 2026 renewal

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：Mastercard 多數客戶關係非排他，客戶可依合約重新評估承諾，也可能自行開發競爭服務。
findings.excerpt: Many of our customer relationships are not exclusive. Our customers can reassess their future commitments to us subject to the terms of our contracts, and they separately may develop their own services that compete with ours.

findings.claim: 10-K 競爭段列出數位錢包等金融科技可用內部帳戶轉帳、帳戶對帳戶即時支付網路處理付款，不經卡網路。
findings.excerpt: Many of these providers have developed payments systems focused on online activity in e-commerce and mobile channels (in some cases, expanding to other channels), and may process payments using in-house account transfers, real-time account-based payments networks or global or local networks, in addition to card.

customer_second_source.note: 搜尋未找到最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製網路的 2026 報導。搜尋摘要提到 Lloyds 將約 1000 萬張卡由 Mastercard 轉 Visa（2026 年底前），但未取得頁面日期，列為 clue。

clues.claim: Lloyds Banking Group 與 Visa 續約擴大，約 1000 萬張信用卡與簽帳卡由 Mastercard 轉至 Visa。
clues.source: Banking Exchange: Lloyds to Transfer 10 Million Cards to Visa
